CVE-2018-6790.title: An issue was discovered in KDE Plasma Workspace before 5.12.0. da ...
CVE-2018-6790.description: An issue was discovered in KDE Plasma Workspace before 5.12.0. dataengines/notifications/notificationsengine.cpp allows remote attackers to discover client IP addresses via a URL in a notification, as demonstrated by the src attribute of an IMG element.
